data: Does the Log-energy decay of h[n] always increase at time increases?

Wait a moment, does it seem right? The caption mentions that the Log-energy decay of h[n] is shown in Figure 3.5. The figure shows a line graph with time on the x-axis and log-energy (dB) on the y-axis. The line appears to be decreasing over time, not increasing. Therefore, the answer to the question is no, the Log-energy decay of h[n] does not always increase at time increases.
